args.intro: We don't have bossa nova directly in our catalog, so I leaned into our smoothest classic and modern jazz selections to give your dinner party that effortless, sophisticated warmth. Here is a handpicked five-track set perfect for dining and conversation.

picks.why: Bill Evans delivers a delicate, gently swaying piano performance from the 1960s with very soft energy and a relaxed, intimate touch.
Dave Brubeck brings an iconic, smooth rhythm with mid-tempo pulse and rich acoustic phrasing that sits naturally in the background of any gathering.
Robert Glasper adds a warm, soulful touch featuring smooth vocals and a contemporary chill jazz groove.
John Coltrane provides an uplifting, melodic waltz with bright acoustic warmth and upbeat valence to keep the mood lively yet refined.
Herbie Hancock layers in breezy, joyful acoustic rhythm and positive vibes to round out your evening feast.

args.closing: Put these on, pour the drinks, and let the easy conversation flow. Enjoy your dinner party!
